deleteOfflineDevicesDialogBody:
When offline devices are removed from $t(branding:com.netdumasoftware.devicemanager), their respective DumaOS settings are also removed. Settings for these devices will need to be reapplied if they reconnect in the future.

Do you still want to remove all offline devices from $t(branding:com.netdumasoftware.devicemanager)?
tourCancel: To take this tour again, open this options menu and press Start Tour.
tourClearAll: If your list of Offline Devices is long, press Clear All to empty it – any new connections that go offline will reappear in the list.
tourClearAllTitle_aria: Clearing Offline Devices pointing to Clear All Offline Devices button
tourCoverPageContent: Device Manager shows connection strengths for your devices and lets you view and edit details for every network device, both offline and online.
tourDeviceList: The Device List contains every device that is currently connected to your network – complete with connection strength and IP address.
tourDeviceListItem: To edit a device’s name or type, select the device from the Device List. You can also see the MAC and IP addresses for the device.
tourDeviceListItemTitle_aria: Editing Device Names pointing to an individual device
tourDeviceListTitle_aria: Reading Your Device List pointing to the page title
tourFinish: That’s everything you need to know! $t(branding:com.netdumasoftware.devicemanager) is the perfect place to make sense of how everything connects in your home. $t(tourCancel)
tourFinishTitle_aria: Last step pointing to the 3 dot popup menu
tourOfflineDevices: Devices that have previously connected to your network but aren’t online are contained in the Offline Devices section.
tourOfflineDevicesTitle_aria: Offline Devices pointing to the Offline Device header
